Charlie and his team provided excellent advice and service with the whole installation. Charlie had previously installed my solar panels and he has now upgraded the system with a Battery. Charlie did a fantastic job of fitting solar, battery and updating my fuse box. I would highly recommend Charlie Sparks for solar and battery installation.

I recently had Charlie from Charlie Sparks install a Tesla Powerwall 3, a new 17kW solar array, and a backup gateway at my home, replacing my old solar system, and the experience was outstanding. Charlie provided a rough quote over the phone, which was reasonable, so we arranged for him to inspect my property. During the inspection, he was thorough, climbing onto the roof to assess the setup. We discussed optimal placement for the Powerwall 3, and he suggested upgrading to a 17kW solar array if budget allowed, without being pushy. His initial quote was competitive, and after I opted for the new array, he provided a revised quote that was very well-priced compared to multiple other quotes I obtained.Charlie and his team were punctual for both the inspection and installation, which impressively happened less than a week later. They efficiently removed the old system and installed the Powerwall 3, 17kW solar array, and backup gateway with professionalism and clean work.Commissioning was seamless, and the system was fully operational the same day. During the quoting process I realised that using a Tesla-certified installer is critical for the Powerwall warranty - Charlie confirmed his certification, which I verified with Tesla, so everything checked out. (Tip: always ensure your installer is Tesla-certified for a TPW3!)The day after installation, Charlie followed up with suggestions for optimising the Powerwall 3 configuration. Since those tweaks, the system has been running perfectly.I've already referred Charlie to a friend and will continue to do so moving forward. I highly recommend Charlie and his team for their competitive pricing, timeliness, and exceptional, clean work. Fantastic job!
